name: Parquet Viewer
description: Browse Apache Parquet files in Orca's editor: a virtualized grid over millions of rows, with the file's schema, row groups and key-value metadata. Read-only.

cover.alt: An events parquet file in Orca: timestamps, user ids, countries and revenue values in a dark grid, with row and column counts in the status bar

screenshots.alt: A 200,000-row file open: the grid shows its first rows while the status bar counts every row
screenshots.caption: Millions of rows scroll smoothly

screenshots.alt: A file with the classic impala types: int32, int64, float, double, text and int96 timestamps side by side
screenshots.caption: Every physical and logical type
